identity.title: [v0.92][C-SDLC v2] Support canonical PRs closing preserved legacy issues

values.review_scope: Issue #3 publication/finish hardening, focused tests, operator contracts, and retained canary evidence.
review_prompts: Can any configured push URL bypass canonical repository verification?
Can pagination or ambiguous PR matches select the wrong remote PR?
Do same-repository and split-authority paths both remain fail-closed?
Does the canary prove real canonical-to-legacy closing causality without overclaiming?
